articles.event_key: WORLD OF HORROR|发布|‘AS BELOW SO ABOVE’大型免费更新
articles.title: WORLD OF HORROR大型免费更新已在PC上线
articles.summary: Ysbryd Games与Panstasz推出大型免费更新“AS BELOW SO ABOVE”，PC版现已上线，PS4和Switch版计划2027年推出。
articles.new_facts: “AS BELOW SO ABOVE”更新已在PC上线；增加约20%内容；PS4和Switch版2027年推出；新增可玩角色与Scenario Mode。
articles.limitations: 仅取得Gematsu对发行商公告的转述，未直接取得Ysbryd Games公告原文。

facts.text: 发行商Ysbryd Games与开发者Panstasz为《WORLD OF HORROR》推出大型免费更新“AS BELOW SO ABOVE”，PC版现已上线，PS4和Switch版计划2027年推出。

evidence.quote: have released a major free update for Cosmic horror RPG WORLD OF HORROR , dubbed “AS BELOW SO ABOVE,” which expands the game with 20 percent more content. The update is available now for PC , and will come to PlayStation 4 and Switch in 2027.

facts.text: 据Gematsu报道，这次更新为游戏增加约20%内容，加入新事件、敌人、谜团、角色、物品、法术、诅咒和伤病，并改善体验、修复问题。更新新增两个古神显现、三名新可玩角色和Scenario Mode。

evidence.quote: adding new events, enemies, mysteries, characters, items, spells, curses, and injuries
along with a large batch of quality-of-life features and bug fixes.
Two never-before-seen manifestations of the Old Gods raise the stakes: IKT-YOSIS, THE FIRST NIGHTMARE, sleeps in a gargantuan chamber beneath the mountains.
Three new playable characters join the fight
The new Scenario Mode adds self-contained stories

bilingual.title_en: Large Free WORLD OF HORROR Update Now Live on PC

sentences.en: Publisher Ysbryd Games and developer Panstasz have released the large free update “AS BELOW SO ABOVE” for WORLD OF HORROR; the PC version is out now, with PS4 and Switch versions planned for release in 2027.
sentences.zh: 发行商Ysbryd Games与开发者Panstasz为《WORLD OF HORROR》推出大型免费更新“AS BELOW SO ABOVE”，PC版现已上线，PS4和Switch版计划2027年推出。

sentences.en: According to Gematsu, the update adds about 20% more content to the game, including new events, enemies, mysteries, characters, items, spells, curses, and injuries and ailments, and improves the experience and fixes issues.
sentences.zh: 据Gematsu报道，这次更新为游戏增加约20%内容，加入新事件、敌人、谜团、角色、物品、法术、诅咒和伤病，并改善体验、修复问题。

sentences.en: The update adds two Old God manifestations, three new playable characters, and Scenario Mode.
sentences.zh: 更新新增两个古神显现、三名新可玩角色和Scenario Mode。

articles.event_key: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game|发布|Avatar State大型更新
articles.title: Avatar Legends格斗游戏推出Avatar State大型更新
articles.summary: Xbox Wire宣布Avatar State更新10月30日上线Xbox Series X|S，重做安昂与Nightmare Korra，重新平衡全部角色。
articles.new_facts: Avatar State更新10月30日上线Xbox Series X|S；重做安昂与Nightmare Korra；加入Ranked Mode 2.0；标准版29.99美元、豪华版49.99美元。
articles.limitations: 信息来自Xbox Wire官方文章，属于发行方口径；未另找独立评测或验证。

facts.text: 微软Xbox Wire宣布，《Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game》的“Avatar State”大型更新已于10月30日上线Xbox Series X|S。更新重做安昂与Nightmare Korra，重新平衡全部角色，并加入Ranked Mode 2.0、故事模式+、新教程和连招挑战。

evidence.quote: The Avatar State Patch is available today for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game on XBOX Series X|S, and it’s the biggest update the game has seen.
Two reimagined fighters. Avatar Aang and Nightmare Korra return with new art, new attacks and new super moves.

facts.text: 官方称这是游戏迄今最大更新，菜单与对战界面也重新设计。标准版售价29.99美元，含Year 1 Pass的豪华版49.99美元；官方还开放新角色投票，候选包括Tenzin、Kuvira、Amon、King Bumi和Asami Sato。

evidence.quote: The Standard Edition is just $29.99, and the Deluxe Edition, which includes the Year 1 Pass, is $49.99.
The candidates are: Tenzin Kuvira Amon King Bumi Asami Sato

bilingual.title_en: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game Launches Major “Avatar State” Update

sentences.en: Microsoft's Xbox Wire announced that the major “Avatar State” update for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game launched on Xbox Series X|S on October 30.
sentences.zh: 微软Xbox Wire宣布，《Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game》的“Avatar State”大型更新已于10月30日上线Xbox Series X|S。

sentences.en: The update reworks Aang and Nightmare Korra, rebalances all characters, and adds Ranked Mode 2.0, Story Mode+, a new tutorial, and combo challenges.
sentences.zh: 更新重做安昂与Nightmare Korra，重新平衡全部角色，并加入Ranked Mode 2.0、故事模式+、新教程和连招挑战。

sentences.en: The official announcement called it the game's largest update to date, and the menus and battle interface have also been redesigned.
sentences.zh: 官方称这是游戏迄今最大更新，菜单与对战界面也重新设计。

sentences.en: The Standard Edition costs $29.99 and the Deluxe Edition, which includes the Year 1 Pass, costs $49.99; officials also opened voting for a new character, with candidates including Tenzin, Kuvira, Amon, King Bumi and Asami Sato.
sentences.zh: 标准版售价29.99美元，含Year 1 Pass的豪华版49.99美元；官方还开放新角色投票，候选包括Tenzin、Kuvira、Amon、King Bumi和Asami Sato。
